name: zutil_zrdr_unload_mounted_archives
description: zUtil_ZRDR::UnloadMountedArchives drains the mounted archive list, freeing archives while optionally preserving the current archive, and requeues the current archive when requested.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
Reconstructed is limited because BN preserves a defensive post-close null check and return-value artifacts for this void-like helper.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly at 0x48d2c0 pops mounted archives from g_zArchive_MountedList, skips and later requeues g_zArchive_Current when destroyCurrentToo is zero, clears g_zArchive_Current when destroying the current archive, closes/free-records and destroys each archive, deletes it, and pushes the preserved current archive back onto the mounted list.

Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x48d2c0 has no warnings or tags and shows the same mounted-list drain, current-archive preservation/destruction behavior, archive close/destroy/delete sequence, and requeue path; known BN artifacts are documented in the function comment.
The dependency frontier for 0x48d2c0 has no visible source blockers; zArchiveList, zIndexArchive, and operator delete dependencies are accepted.

The native zreader_mount_index_archive_smoke mounts an index archive, validates lookup/open behavior, calls zUtil_ZRDR_UnloadMountedArchives(1), and verifies the mounted/current archive teardown path is usable.
